translation_entry.source:
Unleash raw, chaotic elemental damage upon your enemy.
		You strike your enemy for %d%% weapon damage in one of blinding sand, disarming acid, freezing and slowing ice, dazing lightning or stunning flames, with equal odds.
		Additionally, you will cause a burst that deals %0.2f of that damage to creatures in radius %d, regardless of if you hit with the blow.
		Levels in Prismatic Slash increase your Physical and Mental attack speeds by %d%%.

		This talent will also attack with your shield, if you have one equipped.
translation_entry.cycle_0_before_target:
向你的敌人释放原始的混乱元素攻击。
		你会等概率地从致盲之沙、缴械酸雾、可冻结并减速的寒冰、眩晕闪电或震慑之焰中选择一种攻击敌人，造成 %d%% 对应伤害类型的武器伤害。
		此外，无论你的元素攻击是否命中敌人你都会对 %d 码半径范围内的生物造成 %0.2f 伤害。
		五灵挥击还会使你的物理和精神攻击速度提升 %d%%。
		如果你装备了盾牌，这一技能也会用你的盾牌攻击。
translation_entry.cycle_1_after_target:
向你的敌人释放原始的混乱元素攻击。
		你会等概率地从致盲之沙、缴械酸雾、可冻结并减速的寒冰、眩晕闪电或震慑之焰中选择一种攻击敌人，造成 %d%% 对应伤害类型的武器伤害。
		此外，无论此次攻击是否命中，你都会对半径 %d 内的生物造成 %0.2f 点相同属性的伤害。
		五灵挥击还会使你的物理和精神攻击速度提升 %d%%。
		如果你装备了盾牌，这一技能也会用你的盾牌攻击。

placeholder_bindings.meaning: Physical and Mental attack-speed increase percentage

attack_mode.without_shield: attackTarget is called once with the selected damage type and weapon-damage multiplier
attack_mode.with_shield: attackTargetWith is called separately for the main-hand combat object and the shield combat object, each with the selected damage type and multiplier

fire_primary.input: successful direct weapon or shield attack scalar after combat processing
fire_primary.remainder_delivery: the remaining half is divided across the three-turn burning effect

fire_burst.relationship: a separate radius projection after attack_mode whose execution is not conditioned on the melee hit result
fire_burst.control_condition: the independent 25% FLAMESHOCK attempt applies EFF_BURNING_SHOCK only if the target passes the stun-applicability check
